name: The Number 7
overview: The number seven in Scripture symbolizes completeness and divine perfection, as seen in God's precise instructions to take animals by sevens in Genesis 7:2 and the repeated lifespan of Lamech in Genesis 5:31. It also reflects spiritual principles such as forgiveness, where Jesus teaches Peter to forgive up to seven times (Matthew 18:21). The establishment and sanctification of the tabernacle in Numbers 7:1 further emphasize the number's association with holiness and divine order. Together, these passages reveal how the number seven underscores God's sovereign design and the fullness of His redemptive work.
